text:
maria-pp: FYI — ACME reached out asking to pilot an Optimize toolkit bundle: batching guidance + prefix/KV caching checks + quantization recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. They want a pilot in ~6 weeks. Thoughts on scope?
aj: That timeline is tight. We should split into an advisor surface (read-only recommendations + perf delta estimates) vs an automated option. Don’t ship quantization pushes without eval safety.
kevin_l: +1. My suggested slices: 1) Recommendation engine (params + expected token savings), 2) Eval hooks & alerting (run customers' prompt sets, surface regressions), 3) Suggest quant profiles with human review and rollback paths.
sasha: For acceptance, we need concrete metrics. Can we aim for: no >1% task-level quality regression on customers' eval set, p95 latency overhead <120ms, and <5% FP on alerts?
maria-pp: That aligns with ACME’s asks. They care about deterministic safety checks for hallucination rates on quant profiles. They can provide a 10k prompt eval corpus for the pilot.
sam-b: Operational notes: we’ll need canary routing + automatic fallback to float32 model if eval alerts trip. Should be explicit in rollout plan. Also add a cost estimate per 1M tokens for each suggested quant profile.
kevin_l: Draft rollout plan (high level):
```
- Phase A (2 wks): Install advisor UI + perf estimator + onboarding for 1 customer
- Phase B (2 wks): Eval hooks enabled, alerting rules, manual review loop
- Phase C (2 wks): Quant suggestion UI + canary autoswitch (manual approve)
```
aj: Proposed launch gating (short checklist):
- 3 pilot customers signed
- Eval pipeline running on their corpora
- Acceptance: no >1% regression on each customer's golden set
- Ops: canary fallback works end-to-end
- Console: per-route cost/latency telemetry visible

sasha: Risks:
- Quantization can change tokenization/outputs subtly — need prompt-level diff tooling
- Eval suite coverage gap — customers' corpora may not hit rare failure modes
- Alert fatigue if thresholds too loose

maria-pp: Risk mitigations: add a diff viewer in the UI showing token diffs + top-k output divergence, provide a preflight summary (latency, accuracy delta, exemplar failures), and default alerts conservative (only high-confidence regressions).
sam-b: Ops TODOs: instrument KV cache hit-rate, batching efficiency delta, and add a simple toggle to revert quant profile per-tenant. Also add a quick runbook for when eval alerts fire.
kevin_l: UX ask: make recommendations exportable (JSON) so customers can run local sims. Also include suggested quant tradeoffs: memory reduction %, expected throughput lift, rough cost savings.
deploy-bot: deploy:infra/optimize-advisor -> canary started (group: alpha-customers).
aj: Questions for ACME to finalize scope:
- Can they share a representative eval set and SLOs we must hold?
- Are they comfortable with manual gating for quant suggestions?
- Which models/regions matter most for them (affects perf estimator)?
maria-pp: I'll get answers today. If ACME insists on auto-apply quant in pilot that's a hard no without stricter acceptance criteria.
kevin_l: Assuming conservative defaults, we can hit the 6-week ship for Phase A+B. Phase C needs more testing.
sasha: I'll draft acceptance test harness for eval-triggered alerts and share a short checklist.
aj: OK — next steps: maria to confirm ACME corpus + SLOs, kevin to formalize phase tasks and perf estimator API, sasha to own eval harness, sam-b to prepare ops toggles. Check back EOD for a final scoping slack message. :thumbsup:
